basis: 1. Locate the 2014 x-axis tick on the population age-share dashboard. 2. Identify the 0-14 years series (blue line, circular markers) and the 65 years + series (red dashed line, square markers). 3. Observe the vertical positions of the markers at 2014: the blue 0-14 years marker is positioned higher on the chart than the red 65 years + marker. 4. Use the visible numeric annotations to calibrate the scales: the blue 0-14 years series has annotations of 14.82% (near 2013) and 14.2% (near 2016), placing the 2014 value in the ~14-15% range. The red 65 years + series has annotations of 20.1% (near 2013) and 21.4% (near 2017), placing the 2014 value in the ~20-21% range. 5. Compare the calibrated values: the 65 years + share (~20-21%) is larger than the 0-14 years share (~14-15%). 6. Map the larger share (65 years +) to the corresponding option.
